title: Большой мышонок
prompt: Tim proudly opens his laptop at a small wooden desk, mother nearby with a folded shirt, warm domestic opening.

title: Одна буковка
prompt: Family Friday tea: father setting cups, Lily eyeing raspberry pie, mother serving, Tim distracted by laptop at end of table.

title: Обновить всё
prompt: Close view Tim confidently pressing laptop trackpad; on screen an expanding cascade of colorful nested window shapes, abstract only.

title: Зелёная галочка
prompt: Tim triumphantly presents laptop displaying one large green checkmark icon, proud smile, warm lamplight.

title: Магазин не открылся
prompt: Tim leaning toward laptop, confused expression, screen has empty shop window icon and loading circle; evening room.

title: Полный чайник
prompt: Father with buzzing phone on kitchen counter calmly fills a large kettle; Tim in background defensively holds his paws up.

title: Откат не помог
prompt: Tim anxiously presses laptop; screen shows two incompatible abstract puzzle pieces separated by red zigzag, no text.

title: Есть ли бэкап
prompt: Mother pauses slicing raspberry pie and looks thoughtfully at worried Tim beside laptop; quiet kitchen conversation.

title: Ёжик с зубной щёткой
prompt: Front door arrival at night: hedgehog with closed laptop and small bag with visible toothbrush; Tim greets him, father behind with folded blanket.

title: Ничего особенного
prompt: Hedgehog seated beside Tim at table, scrolling long red-and-green abstract change bars on laptop with wired mouse; Tim sheepish.

title: Одна галочка
prompt: Lily peers at laptop with red abstract error blocks and a single green checkmark, Tim points at green icon, hedgehog beside them.

title: Руководитель участвует
prompt: Hedgehog gently lifts Tim paw from keyboard. Laptop shows small badger avatar and thumbs-up icon in abstract chat layout, no actual text. Badger is only on screen.

title: Вдруг поможет
prompt: Hedgehog closes tired eyes, Tim suggests an idea with raised paw, father slides a plate with pie toward hedgehog. Night kitchen.

title: Тестовый стенд
prompt: Tim and hedgehog actively work side by side, examining two laptops; one screen abstract red error shapes, other clean green test indicators; focused cooperation.

title: Быстро, до рассвета
prompt: Dawn blue light in kitchen window. Mother divides last small slice of pie, tired father and hedgehog, relieved proud Tim and sleepy Lily. Laptop has simple cheese shop pictogram.

title: Не ищем виноватых
prompt: Monday meeting around wooden table: badger manager calmly explaining, Tim writes in notebook, hedgehog listening, bright daylight, no text.

title: Дождаться ёжика
prompt: Tim closing laptop with sly innocent sideways glance; hedgehog awake in adjacent armchair holding mug, cozy room, quiet comic ending. No sinister atmosphere.
